title: Arsenal Smash Man City 3-0 in Season Opener!
summary:
Imagine scoring a goal just 24 seconds into the first game of the season. That's exactly what Arsenal's Riccardo Calafiori did against Manchester City on Sunday! The Gunners won 3-0 in the Community Shield, a special match that kicks off the English football season. It was a big win for Arsenal, who are the current Premier League champions.

The game was played in Cardiff, Wales, and Arsenal looked super strong. After Calafiori's super-fast goal, Kai Havertz scored with a header before halftime. Then Martin Odegaard added another goal after the break. Arsenal's new player Bruno Guimaraes, who cost 75 million pounds (that's about $101 million!), played really well in midfield. Another new guy, Christos Tzolis, helped set up two goals.

For Manchester City, it was a tough day. Their new manager, Enzo Maresca, was coaching his first game for the team. He used to coach Chelsea, but now he has a big job: trying to beat Arsenal. Last season, Arsenal won the title and City came in second, seven points behind. City's old manager, Pep Guardiola, won lots of trophies, but now Maresca has to figure out how to catch up.

Arsenal's manager, Mikel Arteta, says his players are still hungry for more trophies. They lost the Champions League final last May, and that made them want to win even more. Arsenal will start their Premier League season on August 21 against Coventry at their home stadium, the Emirates. City will play Bournemouth on August 23. If this game was a preview, Arsenal fans have a lot to be excited about!
why_it_matters: Just like a strong first day can give you confidence for a whole school year, Arsenal's fast start may give them momentum for the season ahead.
